versions.content: Service Name V2x Btp_ Copy Tx Data Syntax Std_ Return Type V2x Btp_ Copy Tx Data ( uint16 Transaction Id16, uint8* Dest Ptr, uint16* Length ) Service ID [hex] 0x06 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different Transaction Id16 Parameters (in) Transaction Id16 ID identifying the payload to be transmitted. This ID is used to get the respective transmit data (BTP header and payload from the V2x Btp module) Dest Ptr Pointer to the buffer where the BTP module shall copy the data to. Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: Data has been copied E_ NOT_ OK: Length does not match Description This API is called by the V2x Gn module to request the V2x Btp module to copy the transmission data to a specific location.
